defects: Uses generic Valuation K ℝ / Valuation L ℝ instead of NumberField.InfinitePlace, losing the number-field/infinite-place structure entirely
h_infinite_v and h_infinite_w are just `True`, not actual formalizations of 'infinite place' — vacuous hypotheses that encode nothing
h_unramified is just `True`, not a formalization of IsUnramified — vacuous hypothesis, the unramified condition is completely dropped
'lies over' is encoded as an arbitrary compatibility condition on valuations rather than the LiesOver structure tied to InfinitePlace, and is not equivalent to w.LiesOver v for infinite places

Conclusion is Module.rank K L = 1 (rank of the whole field extension L over K), not Module.finrank v.Completion w.Completion = 1 (rank of the completions at the places) — this is a mathematically different and generally false statement, since it would force [L:K] = 1 always
No completion objects (v.Completion, w.Completion) appear at all, so the theorem does not address the actual content of the informal statement
